description: Canonical observer envelope, deterministic allowlisted output plan, and bounded PR-writer refusal cases.
refuse: observer envelope keys other than receipts, findings, and reviewCandidate
runtime catalog or generated SDK artifact paths
artifact code execution or patch application
human-edited bot branch without matching managed provenance
main moving after the frozen lease
workspace that is not clean, pinned, and promotable
unexpected paths in the existing or proposed branch diff
managed branch parent, declared output path set, or byte-exact content digest mismatch
workflow run whose returned head or run identity is not bound to the bot commit
automatic approval, merge, tag, release, or publication
